facts.title: spicy squash salad with lentils and goat cheese
ingredients: 6 cups peeled, seeded and cubed butternut squash or sugar pumpkin (1-inch cubes) (from about a 2-pound squash)
1 tablespoon red wine vinegar, plus additional to taste
Roasted seeds (about 1/2 cup) from your butternut squash (optional; see note above)
facts.yield_text: Serves 6 as an appetizer, 3 as a main
facts.author: Deb Perelman
